descriptionByLocale.it:
At Nestlé Suisse S.A. we believe that the future of work is all about Human Relations, and that's why we place our employees at the heart of everything we do. We offer an environment where we embrace winning the hearts and minds of people, demonstrate resilience, and equip our employees to drive their personal health and well-being. But that's not all - we also offer the opportunity to dare, to provide inspiration, innovate, and instil a willingness to be ambitious, take risks, and embrace change. Don’t miss the opportunity to join us and be part of an agile, dynamic, and caring workplace where you can make a difference. Position Snapshot Location: La-Tour-De-Peilz, Suisse Company: Nestlé Suisse S.A. Act. Rate: Act. Rate 80% to 100% Type of contract: Permanent contract Application deadline date: May 1st, 2026 What we offer at Nestlé Flexible combination of office-based and remote work. Please talk to us during the recruitment process about what flexibility could look like for you! Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through mentoring, developing, upskilling, and reskilling Modern “smart office” locations providing agile & collaborative workspaces to connect, collaborate, celebrate, and create Dynamic, diverse, and inclusive international working environment Attractive additional advantages such as “dogs at work”, mobility plan and more Position Summary As a Corporate Channel Development Manager , you will contribute to Nestlé business growth by shaping effective channel and promotional strategies. You will design and deliver cross‑category, multi‑brand promotional initiatives that create value for retail partners, shoppers, and Nestlé, working closely with commercial and sales teams across the market. A Day in the Life of a Corporate Channel Development Manager
• Co‑develop retail channel strategies in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external partners to support Nestlé growth ambitions.
• Design and execute budgeted, multi‑brand promotional plans across priority retail channels and key trade partners, with support of other team members.
• Drive retailers’ engagement and coordinate with Sales and Commercial Development teams to ensure high‑quality execution of in‑market activations.
• Develop innovative shopper‑centric promotions in partnership with agencies and clients to maximise impact and effectiveness.
• Build internal capabilities by defining clear in‑store execution standards (Picture of Success) and continuously improving promotion performance evaluation and planning processes.
• Contribute to key commercial planning cycles, including monthly and annual planning, performance reviews, and cross‑functional initiatives.
• Support the coaching and development of junior team members, helping to grow future commercial talent What will make you successful
• University degree or equivalent in economics, marketing, business management, or a related field.
• Proven experience in demand‑generating roles such as sales, category management, or commercial development; marketing experience is a plus.
• Strong understanding of trade landscape, shopper behaviour, and commercial levers such as promotions, point‑of‑sale materials, and assortment.
• Excellent project management and stakeholder collaboration skills in cross‑functional environments.
• Demonstrated strategic thinking and long‑term planning capability.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
• Fluent in English; professional proficiency in German is required. French is a plus. Nestlé is committed to the accessibility of its recruitment process. If you require an adaptation during the recruitment process, please do let us know so we can support you effectively. All information will be treated confidentially. At Nespresso Switzerland, we believe that we can elevate the world of coffee to drive a positive impact and be a force for good. Voted best employer 2025, we place our people at the heart of our success – all 14,000 of them. To achieve this, we live by four behaviors. We Inspire, we Care, we Act, and we iNnovate. Want to be part of this exciting journey? Join the Nespresso team- Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become. Position Snapshot Location: Avenches, Switzerland & frequent mobility to other Nestlé’s sites Company: Nestlé Nespresso SA Act. Rate: Full-Time, 100% Type of contract: Internship, 6 months Start date: July 2026 The recruitment will be entirely driven by the fit between the individual competencies and the requirements of the job. Each candidate whose skills match best the requirements of the role will be considered. What we offer at Nestlé Flexible work policies in terms of core hours International, diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment : Read more about our Nestlé Community Opportunities to have an impact and contribute to your team’s success Endless learning opportunities and enriching experiences Strong mentorship for your professional growth Professional network and route to entry level position Position Summary For our Supply Chain department, we are looking for a Supply Chain Intern reporting to our Factories Planning Manager for Coffee. In this role, you will contribute to stock cover optimization and gain hands-on experience in project management. You will collaborate closely with Nespresso Factories, Packaging suppliers, and Production & MRP Planners to execute projects aimed at optimizing stocks and workload. This internship provides an excellent opportunity to learn and develop skills in project management, supplier relationship management, and process improvement, while observing how Continuous Improvement Project Plans are built and executed. A Day in the Life of a Supply Chain Intern
• Manage projects focused on continuous improvement for Nespresso
• Help overseeing inventory management for packaging materials
• Implement new methods to optimize packaging stocks and workload
• Collaborate with Production & MRP planners, suppliers, and procurement teams
• Engage with logistics, finance, and other professionals within the supply chain
• Assist in executing strategies to enhance operational efficiency
• Learn managing different steps of the products’ lifecycle What will make you successful
• Completing a Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field
• Having a previous experience in supply chain and/or project management is considered a plus
• Great project management competencies and organizational skills
• Autonomy and the ability to work independently
• Excellent communication skills to work in an international setting with various stakeholders
• Strong analytical skills with an expertise in Microsoft Excel and agility to quickly learn the use of other software
• Basic knowledge in PowerBI and Machine Learning are a plus
• Knowledge of SAP is an advantage
• Fluency in English, both written and spoken; knowledge of French or other European languages is a plus Nespresso is committed to the accessibility of its recruitment process. Découvrez notre page Linkedin : Nespresso Centres de production Découvrez nos métiers : Métiers Nespresso - YouTube Résumé du poste En tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur Engineering (H/F/D) , vous participerez aux revues opérationnelles maintenance, à la préparation, à la mise en œuvre et au suivi des indicateurs et aux projets d’amélioration. • Définir et appliquer la méthodologie appropriée pour gérer un projet d’envergure transversale
• Optimiser nos processus de fonctionnement internes (département Engineering, magasin technique)
• Optimiser la gestion de notre stock de pièces de rechange (stock, taux de rotation, etc.)
• Travailler sur la fiabilisation des équipements industriels
• Participer à l’amélioration continue
• Définir et appliquer la méthodologie appropriée pour gérer un projet d’envergure transversale
• S’assurer de la bonne application de nos règles de sécurité, qualité, hygiène et environnement
• Contribuer à un travail de groupe efficace
• Communiquer de façon transparente et précise. Vos atouts pour réussir
• Elève-Ingénieur/e en dernière année de formation en génie mécanique
• Expérience terrain dans un département engineering ou production, un atout
• Expérience en gestion de projet, un atout
• Capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes
• Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais Chez Nespresso, nous avons bâti une culture fondée sur la bienveillance et l’inclusion, où chacun peut être soi-même, tout en grandissant avec l’entreprise. descriptionByLocale.it:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland Work model: Hybrid / Full time Contract type / duration: Permanent Start date: As soon as possible Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet. At Nestlé, our purpose is to unlock the power of food and beverages to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. As a Adult Nutrition Strategy Manager at Nestlé, your mission is to lead the global strategic agenda for a key category of the Nutrition & Health Business Unit (SBU) , with key brands like NIDO, Vital Proteins, Solgar and Pure. You’ll make a difference by driving the strategic direction for portfolio evolution, competitive assessments, category outlook, business model innovation, and collaborating closely with category leaders, market and zone teams, Finance, Marketing and M&A partners. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale, by shaping the medium and long-term growth agenda for Adult Nutrition, across key platforms such as lifestyle proteins, healthy longevity, weight management. How you’ll make an impact as an Adult Nutrition Strategy Manager
• Analyzing category trends and assess implications for Nutrition & Health pillars globally and across key markets.
• Driving key strategic projects for Adult Nutrition pillar, including category outlook and opportunity sizing, competitive reviews, and brands portfolio evolution.
• Connecting business performance data, consumer insights, and category data to deliver clear and actionable recommendations.
• Leading or supporting M&A assessments: evaluate targets, build global business cases, coordinate with Zones, Finance, M&A and Legal teams, and manage the M&A pipeline.
